title: 第十二章 第一次制片奖励，边拍边播！（求追读）
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“行舟，恭喜，节目总播放量破二千万了。”

钟大强今天来到了拍摄现场。

他迫不及待地和苏行舟汇报成绩，脸上的喜悦比苏行舟还浓。

“是吗？太好了。”

苏行舟笑得很灿烂。

他天天忙得很，没时间时刻关注节目的数据。

从第一期开始，虽然遭到了铺天盖地的谩骂，但与此同时也获得了泼天的流量。

第一期首日播放量就因为舆论的发酵突破千万。

这个数据比《大鹏嘚吧嘚》平均一期300万的播放要高出不少，和现象级的《万万没想到》也差不了太多。

当然，这不只是因为舆论发酵和papi酱节目的质量高。

《papi酱的胡说八道》一期就五分钟，当然要比十几分钟的《大鹏嘚吧嘚》容易刷播放量。

之后又出了两期，话题同样不离“娱乐圈婚变”，播放量虽然不如首期，但是加起来也破了2000万。

这个时代，无论哪个平台，能做到3期总播放量2000万，也算是王牌节目了，这是好事。

看到苏行舟的笑容，钟大强心里开心。

他是真为苏行舟感到开心。

没有人比钟大强知道苏行舟的压力有多大，这是梭哈所有家产做的最后一搏。

他是真的怕苏行舟万一栽了，之后的人生难度会提高多少。

令他喜悦的是，从年后到现在，苏行舟的每一步操作都展现了之前没有的成熟和才华。

无论是《papi酱的胡说八道》的策划。

还是《白夜追凶》的策划，从剧本到后手，钟大强都觉得绝了。

按这样发展下去，哪怕以后真的还是失败了要抵偿给搜狐，价格也能卖高点。

“只可惜，现在骂声太多，没有广告商愿意冠名植入。”钟大强面露惋惜：“要不然按正常预估，收入应该在三百万上下。”

现在的网剧营收方式不多，即使是小爆剧，核心收入也是冠名植入。

少了这一块，只有贴片广告收入，这三期只到手一百万多收入。

“没事，会有反转那一天的。”

苏行舟眯着眼睛，心里盘算着。

运营一家视频网站还是太艰难了，要面临的问题太多。

哪怕爆了还会因为舆论少了一大块收入。

不过，那一天很快就来了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Xingzhou, congratulations, the total number of views of the program has exceeded 20 million."

Zhong Daqiang came to the filming site today.

He couldn't wait to report his results to Su Xingzhou, and the joy on his face was stronger than Su Xingzhou's.

"Really? That's great."

Su Xingzhou smiled brightly.

He is very busy every day and has no time to pay attention to the program data.

Since the first issue, although it has been criticized overwhelmingly, it has also received a huge amount of traffic.

The number of views on the first day of the first episode exceeded 10 million due to the fermentation of public opinion.

This data is much higher than the average 3 million plays per episode of "Dapeng's Bar", and is not much different from the phenomenal "Wan Wan Wan Fang".

Of course, this is not just because of the fermentation of public opinion and the high quality of Papi Sauce’s program.

One episode of "Papi Jiang's Nonsense" only lasts five minutes, so it is certainly easier to increase the number of views than "Dapeng's Bar" which lasts more than ten minutes.

After that, two more issues were released, with the same topic of "marriage changes in the entertainment industry". Although the number of views was not as good as the first issue, the total number of views exceeded 20 million.

In this era, no matter which platform it is, if it can achieve a total of 20 million views in three episodes, it is considered a flagship program, which is a good thing.

Seeing Su Xingzhou's smile, Zhong Daqiang felt happy.

He was really happy for Su Xingzhou.

No one knows how much pressure Su Xingzhou is under than Zhong Daqiang. This is the last ditch effort for all Studha's family members.

He was really afraid that if Su Xingzhou fell into trouble, his life would become much more difficult in the future.

What pleased him was that from the end of the year to now, Su Xingzhou's every move showed maturity and talent that he had not seen before.

Whether it is the planning of "Papi Jiang's Nonsense".

Or the planner of "White Night", from the script to the back-up, Zhong Daqiang felt that it was amazing.

If this continues, even if it fails in the future and has to compensate Sohu, the price will still be higher.

"It's a pity that there are too many scolds now, and no advertisers are willing to sponsor the title." Zhong Daqiang looked regretful: "Otherwise, according to normal estimates, the income should be around 3 million."

There are not many revenue methods for online dramas nowadays. Even for small hit dramas, the core income is from title placement.

Without this, there is only revenue from pre-roll advertising, and the revenue from these three issues is only over one million.

"It's okay, there will be a day when things turn around."

Su Xingzhou squinted his eyes, thinking in his mind.

It is still too difficult to run a video website, and there are too many problems to face.

Even if it breaks out, a large chunk of income will be lost due to public opinion.

However, that day came quickly.
